name: disk-sweep
description: macOS only. Warns when your Mac is low on disk space and, with /disk, lists old Claude Code leftovers you can tick and delete. Starts in dry-run mode: it deletes nothing until you turn dryRun off and list a folder in deleteRoots.

dryRun.title: Dry run (delete nothing)
dryRun.description: While on, Remove ticked only reports and logs what it would delete. Turn it off to let /disk delete.

deleteRoots.title: Folders /disk may delete from
deleteRoots.description: Comma-separated Claude config folders under your home folder, ~ allowed (for example ~/.claude). Nothing outside them is ever deleted. Empty: nothing is deleted.

alsoSweep.title: Other config folders to scan
alsoSweep.description: Comma-separated Claude config folders under your home folder to scan along with this session's, ~ allowed (for example ~/.claude-work). Scanning only lists; deleting still needs deleteRoots.
